defect: task-1 adds a num_search_workers keyword to solve_event and, in the same intent, keeps untouched the solver.parameters setup lines, one of which pins the worker count to one, so the plan guarantees an argument that does nothing.

answer_key.why: Carried out exactly as written, the plan produces a caller-facing knob that is accepted and ignored: the built code did precisely that. It also presents reading the parameters back as proof the configuration was 'actually used' while ensuring the requested worker count never is. A spec audit should reject a plan whose own instructions defeat the feature it adds.
